notes.title: Keep the Adventure Going!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 

Today’s update for Jack Axe features a few quality-of-life fixes, including a reworked save system that allows you to keep playing from a different device without losing progress. We hope you enjoy axe throwing between devices!  

[u][b]The full list of changes are: [/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Changed how the game saves data. This should enable players to transfer their progress from one device to another. 
[*] Added Steam Screenshot functionality (press F12) 
[*] Fixed a bug where the game drops incorrect number of coins upon death. 
[*] Fixed a bug that shows weird red bars in certain levels when pressing space. 
[*] Fixed sound playing when colliding with shrines.
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/985780/Jack_Axe/

- Fixed a bug where an NPC has an "undefined" name.
- Fixed a bug where Jack can dash as soon as she enters the water. It should not supposed to happen.

notes.title: PAX Online Announcements!
notes.content:
We just announced five cool new indie games at PAX Online. What did you think of the show? In case you missed it, here’s a quick rundown on what we had. 
[u][b]As a bonus we have Exclusive Demos of our games available to play right now![/b][/u]

[h1]Jack Axe[/h1]
Jack is her name, and axes are her game in this fantasy platformer about colorful landscapes, amazing acrobatics, and little girls wielding massive axes. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/985780/Jack_Axe/

[h1]The Legend of Tianding[/h1]
A 2D sidescrolling action game set in Taipei at the turn of the 20th century, see the story of Taiwan’s battle for freedom from Imperial Japan through the eyes of a legendary hero: Liao Tianding! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1406850/The_Legend_of_Tianding/

[h1]My Lovely Wife  [/h1]
Save your wife and lose your soul in this management sim about summoning and using succubi to bring someone you love back from the dead.  

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1251930/My_Lovely_Wife/

[h1]Lamentum[/h1]
A 2D Survival Horror game set in, where else, a haunted manor. Guide Victor through deadly traps, mind-bending puzzles, and past the jaws of terrifying monsters to rescue his missing wife Alissa.  

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1033950/Lamentum/

[h1]Doors of Insanity[/h1]
An RPG Card Battler where death and loot alike lurk behind every door! Create a custom character, put on the right equipment, build your deck, and battle your way out of purgatory! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1268810/Doors_of_Insanity/

[h1]You can watch the full announcement video here:[/h1]
[previewyoutube=uRvw5tKBAg8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]And some wacky bloopers![/h1]
[previewyoutube=TdGyHAM9w9A;full][/previewyoutube]


[h1]But Wait! There's More![/h1]

We've joined the United Servers of Discord Alliance! This alliance brings together Discord guilds for fun events and server vs server battles!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32940668/c71949681d90bccf39e276045e1db86097d954a7.png[/img]

Join https://discord.gg/nd for all details. We've prepped a special event just for PAX Online with loads of awesome prizes!

The AllianceTrivia Bot will enable trivia battles between multiple Discord communities! Try your hand at answering trivia questions and help us win our battles against other servers!

When you have a chance check out the #alliance-trivia channel and show off your trivia skills. New trivia battles happen in this same channel automatically every 8 hours at 12AM, 8AM, and 4PM UTC, so if you miss out on the first battle then don't worry because there will be a lot more coming daily!

If you are interested in learning more about the Alliance then feel free to check out this presentation: http://hyperurl.co/DiscordAlliance

notes.title: Jack Axe August Update!
notes.content:
[h1]BRIDGES AND ENEMIES[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34092017/b6daaa8735e543161b247b5da1208c0fbf337a21.png[/img]

As we went near completion, we also took time to make our open areas more fun to explore. We’ve made some minor graphical changes on the bridges and trees on Freymont that we believe better fit the theme and looks more engaging in game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34092017/fefd40a5a60d315ebd3bc34bcf8cc0bfd9c29a6c.gif[/img]

We’ve also added Mini Yeti in the game that throws snowballs at a fixed angle.

[h1]SHOPS AND MINI-GAMES[/h1]

Challenges and levels sometimes get too hard in Jack Axe, so we’ve also added mini-games into the game so players can take a break from the main quest. Each mini-game will reward the players once a certain goal is reached.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/FEMHvMF.gif[/img]
[b]Mini-game #1[/b]: Jester Star Ball Juggling

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34092017/018c6173a09bf7406562cd93a696ecad3a33cf1b.png[/img]
[b]Mini-game #2[/b]: Jester’s Wheel of Treasures

We’ve also added in-game shops that let you personalize Jack in exchange of gold. These shops can be found in every level and offer’s varieties of tint dusts to choose from. Shopkeeper says that it's collected from fairy dust and some are pretty rare to find.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34092017/f8cc7ac14198633640c54b6186f3b1eadd4d5037.gif[/img]

[h1]NEW LEVELS[/h1]

More fun and exciting level awaits you. From snow lands to a hot desert, you will also explore the mystic forest, sparkly beach to the flying ships up the skies.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/6K7bKM5.gif[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/a8KCYWn.gif[/img]

[h1]MINOR CHANGES AND FIXES[/h1]

Compared to the previous demos, the current game plays differently now. We made sure that all of the players' feedback is taken into consideration.  From the characters movement to how the game will be played. We want to offer the best experience possible.

[u]Here are the list of changes we’ve made:[/u]

1. Game now supports multiple save slots
2. Added assist mode so players can play however they want or test difficult levels.
3. Bosses now drop triple rune instead of golden coin
4. Runes are now only stored in Fairy portals (previous versions has doors that requires rune to open)
5. Crasher traps should not be able to detect players when line of sight is blocked
6. Blue fish now kills player on contact
7. Changed turtle movement pattern
8. Red key should not be able to unlock all colored blocks
9. Golden scarab now automatically enchants axe with light that enable players to see in the dark.
10. Puzzle blocks can now be reset using reset targets
11. Some in game sounds now can only be heard depending on the source position. Meaning falls or a bullet sounds louder when it’s near.
12. Screenshakes now only plays when inside the camera
13. UI now has an additional text that displays how much gold you’ve gained and spent.
14. Runes are now displayed in numbers instead of icons. It makes the display cleaner and more unified.
15. A short text with an icon now appears when the game is being written and saved.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/985780/Jack_Axe/

notes.title: 🌳Yggdrasill has a new hope!🌳 (0.2.16)
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34129069/390d67d270e6023bc1f1c9dee8e9eef7d7dff537.gif[/img]

[h1][b]The tree of life, 🌳Yggdrasill🌳 has opened the doors to the Neverinth once more and summoned another fearless heroine to its halls. [/b][/h1]
She too faces the task of returning the universe to balance and restoring Valhalla to its former glory. 
Along with her trusted katana, she brings a unique set of abilities adding a touch of elegance and poise to Neverinth’s brutal combat. 
In addition, two new weapons (Freeze Bomb and Energy Mead) and three more jewels will be available in her path to the sacred halls reconquest.

[h1]Check out all the new updates![/h1]
[olist] 
[*]Added：New character – Proud Aspirant 
[*]Added：New weapon Type – Katana 
[*]Added：New skill for the Cultist Mentor boss 
[*]Added：2 New Items 
[*]Added：3 New Jewelry 
[*]Added：1 New Grace 
[*]Added：Customized control settings 
[*]Added：UI prompts will change with different controller/keyboard 
[*]Added：BGM volume control. Sound Effect control  
[*]Added：Motion blur switch 
[*]Added：Japanese localization  
[*]Added：Totem tutorial 
[*]Adjustment：UX adjustment of Totem system (especially with mouse & keyboard) 
[*]Adjustment：Mouse camera control improvements. System- Camera speed ​​unit refinement 
[*]Adjustment：Value adjustment of Bosses – Gram. Cultist Mentor 
[*]Adjustment：Broaden the room of first level (Broaden some part of first level) 
[*]Bug fix：Enemies stop sometimes after we hit them 
[*] Character control improvements 
[/olist] 
[h1][h1]Adjustment of Totem Power[/h1] 
[/h1]
[list] 
[*]Garm Totem：Attack stamina consumption -70% -> -50%、Life Debt restoration with attack +35% -> +25% 
[/list] 
[h1][h1]Adjustment of Jewelry ability [/h1] 
[/h1]
[list] 
[*]Power of Will：When consuming stamina, increase damage % based on current stamina divided by 12 -> 10. 
[*]Earring of Exertion：Damage increases by 1% for every 5 -> 3 stamina points consumed 
[*]Frostbitten Necklace：Shield +180 -> +120. Increases damage taken by 30% -> 35% but freezes the nearby attacker. 
[*]Earring of Adrenaline：Shield +150 -> +70. Physical defense +2 -> +10 
[*]Earring of Proficiency：Shield +400 -> +250  
[*]Earring of Exchange：Shield +280 -> +200. When shielded, every 500 -> 300 Essence possessed by the character will increase damage by 1% 
[*]Alchemist's Ring：Shield +200 -> +150 
[/list]
